title: Kissed Chicken Pancake Scallion Stir Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired dish that combines savory pancake with sweet and sour chicken and scallions.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine pancake mix and 1 cup of water. Stir until smooth.
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of kissed oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
3. Pour 1/4 cup of pancake batter into the skillet and cook until bubbles form.
4. Flip the pancake and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
5. Repeat with remaining batter to make 4-6 pancakes.
6. In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of kissed oil over medium-high heat.
7. Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes per side.
8. Add the chopped scallions to the pan and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
9. Stir in tangy sauce and cook for 1-2 minutes.
10. Serve the chicken and scallion mixture over the pancakes.
